flows.title: Create and publish a job
steps: Create the job manually in the job editor.
Type the job title, using an auto-suggested title where one fits, and select the department from the dropdown menu.
Set the job location: a city under Office location for an on-site or hybrid job, or at least a country or state under Employee location for a remote one.
Fill out the job description, requirements and benefits, check the targeting details at the bottom of the page, and click Save & continue to go on to the application form, or Save draft.
When ready, click Publish at the top right. A standard access member is prompted to send a publish request to an account admin instead.

flows.title: Add a candidate to a job by hand
steps: Open one of the job's stages, for example Sourced. The candidate is added to the stage being viewed.
Click Add candidates in the upper right, then click Add manually.
Enter the information you have about the candidate in the form and click Add to Sourced. A resume can be added later by editing the candidate's profile.

flows.title: Edit a requisition
steps: Navigate to the Hiring Plan dashboard, click the three dots next to the requisition, and select Edit requisition.
Edit fields such as the associated job, the requisition owner or hiring manager, and the dates. Hiring Managers and above can edit open, pending, approved and rejected requisitions.
Some fields need re-approval when edited; Hiring Plan settings show which.
